ble. 4. The bidder must fulfil the minimum annual turnover criteria prescribed under the bid. The turnover c ertificate issued by the Chartered Accountant shall bear a valid UDIN, wherever applicable. 5. An undertaking on the firm's letterhead confirming compliance with the applicable provisions of Ge M and Rule 149 of the General Financial Rules (GFR), along with other relevant procurement provisions, shall be submitted with the technical bid. 6. A duly signed Bid Security Declaration shall be uploaded along with the technical bid, wherever appl icable, in accordance with the provisions specified in the bid. 7. The bidder shall submit an undertaking on the firm's letterhead confirming acceptance of the applic able Liquidated Damages (LD) provisions in the event of delay or failure in supply or performance, a s prescribed under the bid conditions. 8. All documents and certificates submitted by the bidder shall be valid, up to date, and verifiable. The relevant bid number, bid date, and bid title shall be mentioned on declarations and undertakings wh erever required. Any discrepancy, false information, or suspected misrepresentation shall be subjec t to verification and appropriate action under applicable rules. 9. The prescribed Earnest Money Deposit (EMD), along with the required supporting details, shall be s ubmitted with the technical bid. Where physical submission is stipulated, the original EMD instrume nt or prescribed hard copy shall be delivered to the concerned department within the specified time and before technical evaluation. EMD exemption shall be admissible only to bidders fulfilling the ap plicable GeM provisions and prescribed eligibility conditions. 10. The bidder shall have an established service support office in the State of Madhya Pradesh. Docume ntary evidence establishing the office address and availability of the required service support faciliti es shall be submitted along with the technical bid. 11. The bidder shall possess at least one year of relevant experience in the supply of similar items. Doc umentary evidence in the form of purchase orders/work orders along with completion certificates or satisfactory performance certificates issued by the concerned Government department or other elig ible authority shall be submitted. 12. Bidders shall ensure submission of all certificates, documents, declarations, undertakings, and other supporting records specifically prescribed under the Bid ATC and applicable bid conditions. Failure t o submit mandatory documents or fulfil the prescribed eligibility requirements may render the bid li able for rejection. 13. The bidder shall submit a duly signed declaration on the firm's letterhead regarding its financial sta nding, confirming that the firm fulfils the financial eligibility requirements and is not subject to any fi nancial restriction or disqualification affecting its eligibility to participate in the bidding process. 14. Wherever specifically prescribed under the experience criteria, the bidder shall submit copies of pur chase orders/work orders for similar items received from the same Government department during t he last three financial years, along with the relevant completion or satisfactory performance certific ates, as applicable. 15. Bidders claiming benefits or exemptions under applicable MSME provisions shall submit a valid MSM E/Udyam Registration Certificate and relevant supporting documents. Such benefits or exemptions s hall be considered strictly subject to the nature of registration, product/service category, and fulfilm ent of the applicable eligibility conditions. 16. The bidder shall submit a notarized affidavit executed on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹100, duly sig ned by the authorized signatory, specifically declaring that: (i) The bidder has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Central Government or State Government Depa rtment, Public Sector Undertaking, autonomous body, or local authority, as applicable. (ii) The bidder shall supply genuine, original, and unused products strictly conforming to the prescribed tec hnical specifications and quality standards. (iii) The bidder shall provide the required after-sales service, installation, commissioning, and warranty su pport in accordance with the terms and conditions of the bid. (iv) All information, declarations, certificates, and documents submitted along with the bid are true, genuin

e, and authentic to the best of the bidder's knowledge and belief. (v) In the event of any established false declaration, forged document, or material misrepresentation, the b idder shall be liable for appropriate action, including rejection of the bid and forfeiture of EMD/security dep osit, wherever permissible under applicable procurement rules. 17. The Buyer reserves the right to examine and evaluate all bids strictly in accordance with the prescri bed eligibility criteria, technical specifications, Bid ATC, and applicable procurement rules. Any bid f ound to be non-responsive or materially non-compliant with the mandatory requirements may be re jected in accordance with the applicable GeM terms and procurement provisions. .
